# redfish_boot_order (Resource)

This Terraform resource is used to configure Boot Order and enable/disable Boot Options of the server. We can Read the existing configurations or modify them using this resource. Restarts the server with reset_type only when the BMC answers the PATCH with a job or task Location; otherwise it does not reboot. Inherited from the Dell provider and not tested on AMI MegaRAC firmware.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# reset_type is used only if the BMC answers with a job that needs a reboot.
resource "redfish_boot_order" "system" {
  redfish_server { redfish_alias = "bmc" }
  boot_order = ["Boot0001", "Boot0002"]
  reset_type = "GracefulRestart"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reset_type` (String) Restart type used when the BMC answers the change with a job or task that needs a reboot to apply. Possible values are: "ForceRestart", "GracefulRestart" or "PowerCycle"

### Optional

- `boot_options` (Attributes List) Options to enable or disable the boot device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--boot_options))
- `boot_order` (List of String) sets the boot devices in the required boot order sequences.
- `boot_order_job_timeout` (Number) Time in seconds that the provider waits for the BootSource override job to be completed before timing out.
- `redfish_server` (Block List) List of server BMCs and their respective user credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--redfish_server))
- `reset_timeout` (Number) Time in seconds that the provider waits for the server to be reset before timing out.
- `system_id` (String) System ID of the system

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the Boot Order Resource

<a id="nestedatt--boot_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `boot_options`

Required:

- `boot_option_enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the boot device.

Optional:

- `boot_option_reference` (String) Redfish ID of the boot option (BootOptionReference, e.g. Boot0001).


<a id="nestedblock--redfish_server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redfish_server`

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Server BMC IP address or hostname
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password for login
- `redfish_alias` (String) Alias name for server BMCs. The key in provider's `redfish_servers` map
- `ssl_insecure` (Boolean) This field indicates whether the SSL/TLS certificate must be verified or not
- `user` (String) User name for login

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is a JSON object with the connection details; add "system_id" if the BMC has more than one system.
terraform import redfish_boot_order.system '{"redfish_alias":"bmc"}'
```
